role: Assigned research engineer and analysis author; no independent scientific review claimed.
verdict: The continuous-dose CRN adaptation trails the unadjusted 60-epoch Control-GRU on this identical onset-matched randomized-dose dataset in all six lambda/epoch arms for both exact and tolerance post-effect direction accuracy: each arm is lower in all four seed pairs, and every nominal 95% paired t interval lies below zero.

supersedes.scope: Only the missing same-dataset diagnostic comparator; earlier reports remain immutable.

methods.aggregation: Unweighted mean of four seed accuracies, calculated from unrounded run.json counts/accuracies.
methods.uncertainty_scope: Seed/split variability conditional on one generated cohort; overlapping patient splits; direction cells are not independent replicates.
methods.multiplicity: Nominal per-contrast 95% intervals; no multiplicity adjustment or general superiority claim.
methods.exact_post_effect: Equality of adjacent-dose difference signs on cells with true difference != 0.
methods.tolerance_post_effect: Classify both differences as zero when abs(delta) <= tau; score cells whose thresholded true class is nonzero.
methods.displayed_precision: Six decimal places; integer counts exact; JSON retains full float precision.

historical_comparison.note: Values quoted from frozen counterfactual reading summary; different intervention and scoring window; no subtraction or paired use.

limits: Only four new 60-epoch Control-GRU fits; no new CRN fits or 120-epoch controls.
The 120-versus-60 comparisons have unequal total epoch budgets; equal epochs do not imply equal compute or training schedules.
The CRN two-stage architecture, losses, dropout and training schedule differ from unadjusted Control-GRU; deficits cannot be attributed solely to balancing.
Randomized dose assignment and matched onset do not establish all state-dose coverage, causal identification or estimator assumptions.
One dataset seed, four model/split seeds and the specified simulator/dose/window limit generalization.
Prior main-grid archive-provenance qualifications and all scientific freezes/review eligibility remain unchanged.
